description: This file defines a React context provider component 'AppContextProvider' that supplies application-wide configuration and utility functions such as date formatting and age calculation to its child components.

methods.name: slotDateFormat
methods.description: Formats a date string from 'DD_MM_YYYY' to 'DD Mon YYYY' using a predefined months array.

methods.name: calculateAge
methods.description: Calculates age based on date of birth string, returning the number of years.
